_review.scope: Only the current art-drop/BRIEF-12.md section B, Beach: two bases and sixteen props. No other output asset receives a verdict. The user wording also mentions peaks/craters/trees/ruins/autumn; those are not Part B in this checkout.
_review.calibration: Good enough to ship beside the approved art. Deliberate low-contrast ground texture and the required fading edges of shading overlays are acceptable; obvious repeat composition and failed subject readability are not.
_review.prior_pass_rule: art-drop/review/critic-r12B-0.json does not exist. No inherited passes apply.

checks.brief_and_references: Read the complete current BRIEF-12, including shared view, lighting, outline, dimensions, footprints, neutral shading and QC rules. Part B names no external image reference. The treeline_forest reference named by Part C was viewed for context only. Also read BRIEF.md and BRIEF-2.md for the established pixel style and approved tile calibration.
checks.approved_art: Visually compared representative approved markers from all six families, round-2 city/industry/slums/suburb/farmland tiles, all eight paddies and all eight grass/plains detail variants in each of four seasons, with ground samples. Saved native and 4x comparison boards. Comparison assets are not re-reviewed or failed.
checks.base_3x3: Both opaque 288x288 bases tiled literally 3x3 and inspected at 1x and 4x. Supplemented with exact 4x single-base and wrap-junction views to inspect pixel clusters. No straight seam or per-cell frame found. Summer contrast is sufficiently quiet; winter repeats its larger snow/sand composition conspicuously and fails.
checks.one_cell_random_8x2: Summer and winter slots 0-3 composited in seeded shuffled 8x2 arrays on matching bases, at 1x and exact 4x. No clipped sprites, backing squares or accidental tile frames. These are independent prop placements; repeated instances of an intentionally reused prop are not themselves a seam.
checks.peak_lattice_or_range: Not applicable: current Part B contains no peaks.
checks.trees_in_forest: Not applicable: current Part B contains no trees. Tree kinds are section C; no tree is added to the verdict.
checks.other_listed_problem_types: Egg-crate peaks, Swiss-cheese craters, classical ruins, cyberpunk ground grids, flat orange autumn and identical crowns are absent from Part B. No implied pass on those out-of-scope assets.
checks.context_1x_4x: All sixteen props inspected on matching beach bases in ordered and scattered layouts at 1x/4x, plus grass/plains and dark-background checks for blending, fringe and unwanted backing. Both tide-pool overlays fail on their intended beach ground.
checks.every_file_8x: Every prop inspected with its entire canvas at exact nearest-neighbour 8x on matching beach and dark ground. Every pixel of each base inspected in four 144x144 quadrants at exact 8x. No source pixel omitted.
checks.technical: All 18 expected PNGs present, nonblank and correctly sized. Bases opaque. Fourteen solid props use binary alpha; both shading-only tide pools use neutral black/white RGB and deliberate stepped alpha from 8 to 64 plus zero. All transparent RGB is zero. All 18 images are byte-unique. Small prop bounds span 36px horizontally; large props span 82px, with transparent margins and no clipping. Shallow objects legitimately use flatter vertical footprints.
checks.art_quality: Individually checked seams/repeat, pixel sharpness, antialiasing, muddy masses/noise, silhouette, placement, margins, fringe/halo, top-left lighting, palette consistency and near-duplicates. The fourteen solid props have distinct subject silhouettes, readable material planes and compatible muted colours. Their winter variants retain the subject and consistent top-facing snow. No additional concrete defect found in the passing files. Tide-pool failures concern surface readability, not the mere presence of required alpha fading.
checks.integrity: SHA-256 before/after inventory confirms all 1402 files in art-drop/out/ unchanged. Verified 51 saved 1x-to-4x/8x proof pairs are exact nearest-neighbour enlargements. Eight base-quadrant 8x proofs and two 4x single-base proofs are generated directly from source crops/canvases.
checks.limits: Offline image review in an art-only checkout; no live-engine placement claim.

beach.assessment: Base and seven solid props ship. The base has quiet damp-sand texture, small shell/pebble marks and no exposed seam/frame. Driftwood, shell group, kelp, barnacled rock, log, root fan and boulder group remain distinct and readable at native size. The tide pool needs a readable water surface.

beach@winter.assessment: Seven solid props ship with consistent top-facing snow, retained silhouettes and compatible snow/stone/wood palettes. The base has conspicuous large-scale repetition; the frozen tide pool loses its structure on the intended ground.

fail.name: beach@winter-base
fail.problems: Visible composition repeat in the 3x3 proof at 1x and 4x: the broad bare-sand clearing around native (200,190), followed by the dense diagonal snow cluster below it, repeats as an obvious row of matching gaps every 288 px. The high-contrast snow also forms repeated parallel streaks. The wrap is joined, but the surface still reads as repeating wallpaper. Rebalance the snow/sand masses: split the large clearing, vary patch sizes and directions, and distribute quieter transitions across the wrap. Recheck the whole 3x3 area, not only the seam cross. Evidence: critic-r12B-1-winter-base-3x3-{1,4}x.png and winter-base-single-4x.png.

fail.name: beach-prop-6
fail.problems: At 1x on its own sand base, the tide pool reads as a fuzzy brown oval shadow or stain, with one isolated pale slash at the upper-left; it does not establish a readable water surface or enclosing shallow bank. At 4x/8x the broad nested alpha bands dominate the shape. Preserve neutral shading-only RGB and the required fade to zero, but redraw the interior with a coherent irregular shallow rim, a flatter quieter surface and a few connected, crisp neutral reflection accents. Fade the outer fringe rather than letting the whole pool become an indistinct smudge. Evidence: critic-r12B-1-summer-all-props-on-beach-{1,4}x.png, summer-beach-scatter-{1,4}x.png and summer-prop-6-beach-dark-8x.png.

fail.name: beach@winter-prop-6
fail.problems: The frozen tide pool nearly disappears into the actual winter beach at 1x and remains a vague lightened patch at 4x. Its two small crack marks are visible on the artificial dark background at 8x but lose their structure over the snow/sand texture; the ground pattern dominates the supposed ice plane. Redraw a readable, flatter frozen surface with a restrained neutral shaded rim and connected, higher-contrast crack/reflection clusters that survive both snowy and bare-sand placements. Keep it shading-only, without an opaque coloured backing, and retain a narrow fading outer edge. Evidence: critic-r12B-1-winter-all-props-on-beach-{1,4}x.png, winter-beach-scatter-{1,4}x.png and winter-prop-6-beach-dark-8x.png.
